component.name: Hikvision Camera Viewer
component.summary: View and record Hikvision DVR cameras

description.p: Monitor Hikvision DVR cameras from a Linux desktop. View HTTP snapshots, embedded RTSP streams, or (with a separately installed official Linux SDK) an experimental Hikvision encrypted-stream backend. Switch between a camera grid and single-camera view, and save snapshots or video recordings.
The application can also display motion events from the DVR and open an RTSP stream in ffplay for high-quality playback.
The optional Hikvision SDK is proprietary and is not included. Encrypted stream decoding is experimental and may not produce video frames on all DVR models or firmware versions.
